description: Defines the CatalogItemOrdered class, a value object that captures a snapshot of an ordered catalog item, including its ID, name, and picture URI. It ensures data integrity via guards and supports entity framework serialization.

classes.name: CatalogItemOrdered
classes.description: A value object representing a snapshot of an ordered catalog item, with properties for ID, name, and picture URI. It ensures immutability after creation and is used to prevent changes to order details after completion.

methods.name: CatalogItemOrdered
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the catalog item snapshot, validating input parameters to ensure correctness.
